case_number: 2024 INSC 687; Criminal Appeal No. 3816 / 2024 (Arising out of Special Leave Petition (Crl.) No. 11023 / 2024) and Criminal Appeal No. 3817 / 2024 (Arising out of Special Leave Petition (Crl.) No. 10991 / 2024)
summary: Arrest legality under CrPC s.41(1) vs s.41(2); misapplication of non-cognizable offense provisions to cognizable case; bail denial due to complexity of evidence and pendency of chargesheet; triple test for bail (flight risk, tampering, criminal background) satisfied as per ED matter precedent; trial delay concerns due to voluminous records (224 witnesses, lakhs of pages); High Court error in redirecting bail application to Trial Court despite concurrent jurisdiction.
legal_provisions_cited: Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgment set aside; bail granted to appellant.
